newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Pop superstar Jackson arrives in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Pop superstar Jackson arrives in Taiwan.

text.p: U.S. pop superstar Michael Jackson arrived in Taipei on Monday after ending a controversial visit to South Korea.
"I love you," Jackson, sporting a wide-brimmed hat, sunglasses and blue outfit, told hundreds of fans and reporters at Taipei international airport.
Jackson is scheduled to perform three concerts in the capital Taipei and in the southern city of Kaohsiung as part of his "HIStory World Tour".

About 50 civic and religious groups in South Korea protested against Jackson's visit but South Korea's Ministry of Culture approved the appearances provided Jackson refrained from making "obscene or vulgar gestures or remarks".
Jackson is drawing little controversy on Taiwan, however.
